claim: Six current-tree manifest omissions caused a post-push verification failure on main. Human-approved PR98 repaired the inventory and retained failure evidence; the resulting main verification passed. Main remained unprotected and PR99's preventive-control proposal remained unimplemented.

observations.description: At 035f631d, inspected CI passed typecheck, 36 Jest suites/112 tests and three Python tests; inventory verification then failed on six exact paths. The change had already reached main.

Absent paths: .github/workflows/interaction-sensor.yml; docs/INTERACTION-SENSOR.md; encyclopedia-of-chaos/reality-benchmarks/RB-001-51-50-failures-contradictions-v0.1.md; research/quora-lane/RESPONSE-RECONCILIATION-v0.1.md; scripts/interaction_sensor.py; tests/test_interaction_sensor.py. Five non-Quora omissions predated the latest Quora commit.

PR98 added inventory records for six existing files plus a failure receipt. Diff: only current manifest and new receipt, 70 additions, zero deletions. No source/test/workflow or branch-policy modification.

Human agreed after a scoped review-and-merge recommendation. Reviewed head 07a7fd08 was merged as 2e3296ca; GitHub returned merged=true. Approval concerned inventory repair, not branch-rule implementation or archive admission.

Post-merge job 118199793913 passed all existing stages; log reports 286 repository files with current ledger matching. This is CI execution evidence within the same GitHub trust domain, not independent specialist verification.

After repair, main endpoint still returned protected=false and required-status enforcement off. Existing September guidance already named protected-branch enforcement unresolved; this observation does not claim a new contradiction in that guidance.
PR99 remained draft/unmerged and was retargeted to main after PR98 merge. No branch settings were applied, no denial tests executed and no independent stop authority established.

environment: GitHub Actions ubuntu-latest, workflow configured for Node 20; Python handoff runner available on hosted image. Logs/source/API inspected by the same assistant; no external execution custody.
limitations: Supported scope is the inspected failure, repair, merge and check lineage; passing checks do not establish safety or complete integrity.
The manifest inventories file bytes, not truth, legitimate authority, independent custody or pre-consequence enforcement.
Main protected=false/off is the observed branch response; organization-wide policy was not independently audited.
Old release snapshots and historical failure records were retained; this entry is not a retrospective declaration that earlier states were valid.
The earlier inventory failure precedes the October 19 GitHub service incident; the latter is not its established cause.
No author, reviewer or check-producer independence established. The same owner can change checks and rules.
No workflow dispatch, live resource test, branch-policy change, deployment or archive admission occurred in this preservation action.

beneficial: Corrected inventory and preserved lineage help successors distinguish repair from enforcement.
harmful: Treating CI detection as a preventive gate may allow invalid states to become current.
